title: muster release v5.43.7

### Fixed
- **A client connection through a gateway survives a replaced aggregator pod.** For a while after muster's pod was replaced, the gateway in front of it answered `upstream call failed: Connect: deadline has elapsed`, and every CLI command failed with `failed to connect to aggregator` on the first such answer, although the new pod was healthy. The agent client's `Connect` now retries a connection that did not reach the aggregator (a refused, reset or timed-out connection, or a gateway's 502, 503, 504 or failed upstream call) with a fresh session for up to 30 seconds, bounded by the caller's context; a 401 or any other refusal is final. `muster auth token` prints a valid stored access token without contacting the aggregator and connects only to renew an expired one. ([#1536](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1536))
